bio.text: Frederick D. Haynes III won the Democratic primary for Texas's 30th Congressional District in March 2026, according to Black Enterprise, which cited CBS News.
KSAT reported in January 2026 that he has been senior pastor of Friendship-West Baptist Church in Dallas for more than 40 years.
He earned a PhD in African American Preaching and Sacred Rhetoric from Christian Theological Seminary in 2025.

sources.title: Jasmine Crockett's pastor, Frederick Haynes III, sees Congress as stage to pursue social justice
Frederick Haynes Wins Democratic Primary For Texas' 30th District
